    const CATALOG_MAP = new Map(CATALOG.map(p => [p.id, p]));

    const FREE_DELIVERY_THRESHOLD = 3000;

    function formatPKR(value) {
      return `PKR ${value.toLocaleString()}`;
    }

    function getCartSubtotal() {
      return cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.qty, 0);
    }

    function getFreeDeliveryState(total = getCartSubtotal()) {
      const remaining = Math.max(0, FREE_DELIVERY_THRESHOLD - total);
      return {
        total,
        remaining,
        progress: Math.min((total / FREE_DELIVERY_THRESHOLD) * 100, 100),
        unlocked: remaining === 0
      };
    }

    function freeDeliveryMarkup() {
      return `
        <div class="free-del-box" data-free-delivery>
          <div class="free-del-top">
            <div class="free-del-label">Free Delivery</div>
            <div class="free-del-left" data-free-del-left></div>
          </div>
          <div class="free-del-track"><div class="free-del-fill" data-free-del-fill></div></div>
          <div class="free-del-msg" data-free-del-msg></div>
        </div>`;
    }

    function renderFreeDeliveryState() {
      const state = getFreeDeliveryState();
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-free-delivery]').forEach(box => {
        box.classList.toggle('unlocked', state.unlocked);
        box.classList.toggle('nudge', !state.unlocked && state.remaining <= 500);
        const leftEl = box.querySelector('[data-free-del-left]');
        const fillEl = box.querySelector('[data-free-del-fill]');
        const msgEl = box.querySelector('[data-free-del-msg]');
        if (leftEl) leftEl.textContent = state.unlocked ? 'Unlocked' : `${formatPKR(state.remaining)} away`;
        if (fillEl) fillEl.style.width = `${state.progress}%`;
        if (msgEl) {
          msgEl.textContent = state.unlocked
            ? 'Free delivery unlocked. Add more if you want, shipping stays free.'
            : `Add ${formatPKR(state.remaining)} more to unlock free delivery.`;
        }
      });
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
       PRODUCT GRID
       Architecture:
       - buildGrid(): renders ALL cards into DOM once
       - filterGrid(): toggles [data-hidden] attribute (no re-render)
       - swapVariant(): swaps img src + pill state in-place
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    function buildFilters() {
      const cats = ['All', 'Heritage', 'Pop Culture', 'Streetwear', 'Art', 'Statement'];
      const bar = document.getElementById('filter-bar');
      bar.innerHTML = cats.map(c =>
        `<button class="f-btn${c === 'All' ? ' on' : ''}" onclick="filterGrid('${c}',this)" aria-pressed="${c === 'All'}">${c}</button>`
      ).join('');
    }

    function buildGrid() {
      const grid = document.getElementById('prod-grid');
      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      CATALOG.forEach((p, i) => {
        cardVariantIdx.set(p.id, 0);
        const el = makeCard(p, i);
        frag.appendChild(el);
      });
      grid.appendChild(frag);
      fadeObserver();
    }

    function makeCard(p, i) {
      const v = p.variants[0];
      const disc = Math.round((1 - p.price / p.cmp) * 100);
      const lowStock = p.stock <= 5;

      const badgeHTML = (() => {
        if (p.badge === 'Trending') return `<div class="pc-badge" style="background:var(--teal)">Trending</div>`;
        if (p.badge === 'New') return `<div class="pc-badge new-badge">New</div>`;
        if (p.badge === '🔥 Hot') return `<div class="pc-badge hot-badge">🔥 Hot</div>`;
        if (disc > 0) return `<div class="pc-badge" style="background:var(--green)">-${disc}%</div>`;
        return '';
      })();

      const pillsHTML = p.variants.length > 1
        ? `<div class="swatches" role="group" aria-label="Color variants">${p.variants.map((v, vi) =>
          `<button class="sw-pill${vi === 0 ? ' on' : ''}" onclick="swapVariant(event,${p.id},${vi})" aria-pressed="${vi === 0}">${v.color}</button>`
        ).join('')
        }</div>`
        : `<span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--mut);letter-spacing:.08em">${v.color}</span>`;

      const el = document.createElement('article');
      el.className = 'pc fade-up';
      el.style.transitionDelay = `${i * 0.05}s`;
      el.dataset.pid = p.id;
      el.dataset.cat = p.cat;
      el.setAttribute('role', 'listitem');
      el.setAttribute('aria-label', `${p.name} — PKR ${p.price.toLocaleString()}`);

      el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="pc-img" onclick="openModal(${p.id})" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="View ${p.name} details">
      <img src="${v.imgs[0]}" alt="${p.name} Premium Canvas Tote Bag Pakistan" loading="lazy" decoding="async"
           onload="this.closest('.pc-img').classList.add('loaded')">
      <div class="pc-cat">${p.cat}</div>
      ${badgeHTML}
      <div class="pc-qa" onclick="qaClick(event,${p.id})" role="button" aria-label="Quick add ${p.name} to cart">
        <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true">
          <path d="M6 2L3 6v14a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2V6l-3-4z"/>
          <line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/>
          <path d="M16 10a4 4 0 01-8 0"/>
        </svg>
        Quick Add
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="pc-info">
      <div class="pc-name">${p.name}</div>
      <div class="pc-tag">${p.tag}</div>
      <div class="pc-btm">
        <div>
          <span class="pc-price">PKR ${p.price.toLocaleString()}</span>
          <span class="pc-cmp">PKR ${p.cmp.toLocaleString()}</span>
          ${disc > 0 ? `<span class="pc-disc">-${disc}%</span>` : ''}
          ${lowStock ? `<span class="pc-stock-warn">⚡ Only ${p.stock} left</span>` : ''}
          ${freeDeliveryMarkup()}
        </div>
        ${pillsHTML}
      </div>
    </div>`;

      // Keyboard support for card image area
      el.querySelector('.pc-img').addEventListener('keydown', e => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); openModal(p.id); }
      });

      return el;
    }

    /* Filter: toggle DOM visibility, zero innerHTML calls */
    function filterGrid(cat, btn) {
      activeFilter = cat;
      document.querySelectorAll('.f-btn').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.toggle('on', b.textContent.trim() === cat);
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b.textContent.trim() === cat);
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-pid]').forEach(card => {
        const show = cat === 'All' || card.dataset.cat === cat;
        card.toggleAttribute('data-hidden', !show);
      });
    }

    /* Variant swap: O(1) lookup, instant img transition */
    function swapVariant(e, pid, vi) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const p = CATALOG_MAP.get(pid);
      if (!p || !p.variants[vi]) return;
      cardVariantIdx.set(pid, vi);

      const card = document.querySelector(`[data-pid="${pid}"]`);
      if (!card) return;

      // Update pills
      card.querySelectorAll('.sw-pill').forEach((pill, i) => {
        pill.classList.toggle('on', i === vi);
        pill.setAttribute('aria-pressed', i === vi);
      });

      // Swap image — fade out → update src → fade in
      const img = card.querySelector('.pc-img img');
      if (!img) return;
      const newSrc = p.variants[vi].imgs[0];
      img.style.opacity = '0';
      // Use rAF to batch the src change after the opacity transition starts
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        img.src = newSrc;
        img.onload = () => { img.style.opacity = '1'; };
        // Fallback: if cached, onload may not fire
        setTimeout(() => { img.style.opacity = '1'; }, 250);
      });
    }

    function qaClick(e, pid) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const p = CATALOG_MAP.get(pid);
      if (!p) return;
      const vi = cardVariantIdx.get(pid) || 0;
      const v = p.variants[vi];
      addToCart(p, v.color);
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
       PRODUCT MODAL
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    function openModal(pid) {
      const p = CATALOG_MAP.get(pid);
      if (!p) return;
      curModal = p;
      const vi = cardVariantIdx.get(pid) || 0;
      curModalColor = p.variants[vi].color;

      document.getElementById('modal-cat').textContent = p.cat;
      document.getElementById('modal-name').textContent = p.name;
      const urduEl = document.getElementById('modal-urdu');
      urduEl.textContent = p.urdu || '';
      urduEl.style.display = p.urdu ? 'block' : 'none';
      document.getElementById('modal-desc').textContent = p.desc;
      document.getElementById('modal-price').textContent = `PKR ${p.price.toLocaleString()}`;
      document.getElementById('modal-cmp').textContent = `PKR ${p.cmp.toLocaleString()}`;
      document.getElementById('modal-stock').textContent = p.stock <= 5 ? `⚡ Only ${p.stock} left in stock` : '';

      updateModalImgs(p, curModalColor);
      buildModalColors(p, vi);

      document.getElementById('modal-add-btn').onclick = () => { addToCart(curModal, curModalColor); closeModal(); };
      document.getElementById('modal-custom-btn').onclick = customOrderWA;
      document.getElementById('modal-wa-btn').onclick = () => {
        const msg = `Hi DRIP! I want to order the *${curModal.name}* tote bag in *${curModalColor}*. PKR ${curModal.price.toLocaleString()}.`;
        window.open(`https://wa.me/923214614145?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`, '_blank', 'noopener');
      };

      const ov = document.getElementById('modal-ov');
      ov.classList.add('on');
      ov.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      setTimeout(() => document.querySelector('.modal-close')?.focus(), 100);
    }

    function updateModalImgs(p, color) {
      const v = p.variants.find(v => v.color === color) || p.variants[0];
      const main = document.getElementById('modal-main');
      main.style.opacity = '0';
      main.src = v.imgs[0];
      main.alt = `${p.name} ${color} Tote Bag`;
      main.onload = () => { main.style.transition = 'opacity .3s'; main.style.opacity = '1'; };
      setTimeout(() => { main.style.opacity = '1'; }, 350);

      const ths = document.getElementById('modal-thumbs');
      ths.innerHTML = v.imgs.map((src, i) =>
        `<img src="${src}" class="modal-th${i === 0 ? ' on' : ''}" onclick="selThumb(this,'${src}')" alt="${p.name} view ${i + 1}" loading="lazy">`
      ).join('');
    }

    function selThumb(el, src) {
      document.getElementById('modal-main').src = src;
      document.querySelectorAll('.modal-th').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('on'));
      el.classList.add('on');
    }

    function buildModalColors(p, activeVi = 0) {
      const row = document.getElementById('modal-col-row');
      if (p.variants.length <= 1) { row.style.display = 'none'; return; }
      row.style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('modal-colors').innerHTML = p.variants.map((v, vi) =>
        `<button class="mc-btn${vi === activeVi ? ' on' : ''}" onclick="selModalColor('${v.color}',this)">${v.color}</button>`
      ).join('');
    }

    function selModalColor(color, btn) {
      curModalColor = color;
      document.querySelectorAll('.mc-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('on'));
      btn.classList.add('on');
      if (curModal) updateModalImgs(curModal, color);
    }

    function closeModalEv(e) { if (e.target === document.getElementById('modal-ov')) closeModal(); }
    function closeModal() {
      const ov = document.getElementById('modal-ov');
      ov.classList.remove('on');
      ov.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
       CART
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    function addToCart(p, color) {
      const ex = cart.find(i => i.id === p.id && i.color === color);
      if (ex) { ex.qty++; }
      else {
        const v = p.variants.find(v => v.color === color) || p.variants[0];
        cart.push({ id: p.id, name: p.name, color, price: p.price, img: v.imgs[0], qty: 1 });
      }
      saveCart(); renderCart(); playAdd();
      toast(`${p.name} (${color}) added to bag ✓`);
      openCart();
    }

    function addById(pid) {
      const p = CATALOG_MAP.get(pid);
      if (p) addToCart(p, p.variants[0].color);
    }

    function saveCart() {
      try { localStorage.setItem('drip_cart', JSON.stringify(cart)); } catch (e) { }
    }

    function renderCart() {
      const count = cart.reduce((s, i) => s + i.qty, 0);
      const badge = document.getElementById('cart-badge');
      badge.textContent = count;
      badge.classList.toggle('on', count > 0);
      const list = document.getElementById('cart-list');
      const ft = document.getElementById('cart-ft');
      if (!cart.length) {
        list.innerHTML = `<div class="cart-empty"><svg width="44" height="44" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 2L3 6v14a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2V6l-3-4z"/><line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/><path d="M16 10a4 4 0 01-8 0"/></svg><p>Your bag is empty.</p></div>`;
        ft.style.display = 'none';
        renderFreeDeliveryState();
        return;
      }
      list.innerHTML = cart.map((item, idx) => `
    <div class="cart-item">
      <img class="ci-img" src="${item.img}" alt="${item.name}" loading="lazy">
      <div class="ci-info">
        <div class="ci-name">${item.name}</div>
        <div class="ci-color">${item.color}</div>
        <div class="ci-price">PKR ${(item.price * item.qty).toLocaleString()}</div>
        <div class="ci-qty">
          <button type="button" class="qty-b" onclick="chgQty(${idx},-1)" aria-label="Decrease quantity">−</button>
          <span class="qty-n">${item.qty}</span>
          <button type="button" class="qty-b" onclick="chgQty(${idx},1)" aria-label="Increase quantity">+</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button type="button" class="ci-del" onclick="delItem(${item.id}, '${item.color}')" aria-label="Remove ${item.name}">×</button>
    </div>`).join('');
      const sub = cart.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
      document.getElementById('cart-total').textContent = `PKR ${sub.toLocaleString()}`;
      ft.style.display = 'block';
      renderFreeDeliveryState();
    }

    function chgQty(idx, d) {
      if (!cart[idx]) return;
      cart[idx].qty = Math.max(1, cart[idx].qty + d);
      saveCart(); renderCart();
    }
    function delItem(pid, color) {
      const idx = cart.findIndex(item => item.id === pid && item.color === color);
      if (idx < 0) return;
      cart.splice(idx, 1);
      saveCart(); renderCart(); playZip();
    }
    function openCart() {
      playZip();
      document.getElementById('cart-ov').classList.add('on');
      document.getElementById('cart').classList.add('on');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }
    function closeCart() {
      document.getElementById('cart-ov').classList.remove('on');
      document.getElementById('cart').classList.remove('on');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

      const msg = 'Hey Drip, I want to customiasde my order';
      window.open(`https://wa.me/923214614145?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`, '_blank', 'noopener');
    }
    function checkoutWA() {
      if (!cart.length) { toast('Your cart is empty!'); return; }
      const lines = cart.map(i => `• ${i.name} (${i.color}) x${i.qty} — PKR ${(i.price * i.qty).toLocaleString()}`).join('\n');
      const total = cart.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
      const msg = `Hi DRIP! I'd like to order:\n\n${lines}\n\n*Total: PKR ${total.toLocaleString()}*\n\nPlease confirm! 🛍️`;
      window.open(`https://wa.me/923214614145?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`, '_blank', 'noopener');
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
       QUIZ
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    function startQuiz() {
      document.getElementById('quiz-intro').style.display = 'none';
      document.getElementById('qc-1').classList.add('active');
    }
    function pickOpt(btn, cat, qNum) {
      const card = document.getElementById(`qc-${qNum}`);
      if (card.dataset.locked === '1') return;
      card.dataset.locked = '1';
      card.querySelectorAll('.q-opt').forEach(b => { b.classList.remove('chosen'); b.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'false'); });
      btn.classList.add('chosen');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'true');
      quizScores[cat] = (quizScores[cat] || 0) + 1;
      quizOrder.push(cat);
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (qNum < 3) {
          card.classList.remove('active');
          document.getElementById(`qc-${qNum + 1}`).classList.add('active');
        } else {
          card.classList.remove('active');
          showQuizResult();
        }
      }, 420);
    }
    function showQuizResult() {
      let topCat = 'Statement', topScore = 0;
      Object.entries(quizScores).forEach(([cat, sc]) => { if (sc > topScore) { topScore = sc; topCat = cat; } });
      if (topScore > 0) {
        const tiedCats = Object.entries(quizScores).filter(([, sc]) => sc === topScore).map(([cat]) => cat);
        if (tiedCats.length > 1) {
          topCat = [...quizOrder].reverse().find(cat => tiedCats.includes(cat)) || tiedCats[0];
        }
      }
      const res = QUIZ_RESULTS[topCat];
      document.getElementById('qr-tag').textContent = res.tag;
      document.getElementById('qr-title').textContent = res.title;
      document.getElementById('qr-sub').textContent = res.sub;
      const img = document.getElementById('qr-img');
      img.src = res.img; img.alt = res.title + ' Tote Bag';
      document.getElementById('qr-shop-btn').onclick = () => openModal(res.pid);
      const waMsg = `Hi DRIP! I took the quiz and got *${res.title}*. I want to order it! 🛍️`;
      document.getElementById('qr-wa-btn').href = `https://wa.me/923214614145?text=${encodeURIComponent(waMsg)}`;
      document.getElementById('quiz-result').classList.add('active');
    }
    function resetQuiz() {
      quizScores = { Heritage: 0, PopCulture: 0, Art: 0, Statement: 0 };
      quizOrder = [];
      document.getElementById('quiz-result').classList.remove('active');
      document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => { delete c.dataset.locked; });
      document.querySelectorAll('.q-opt').forEach(b => { b.classList.remove('chosen'); b.setAttribute('aria-checked', 'false'); });
      document.getElementById('quiz-intro').style.display = 'block';
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
       COUNTDOWN
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    function startCountdown() {
      let end;
      try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem('drip_botw_end');
        end = saved ? parseInt(saved) : null;
        if (!end || end < Date.now()) { end = Date.now() + 18 * 3600000; localStorage.setItem('drip_botw_end', end); }
      } catch (e) { end = Date.now() + 18 * 3600000; }
      const fmt = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
      const tick = () => {
        const d = Math.max(0, end - Date.now());
        const h = document.getElementById('cd-h');
        const m = document.getElementById('cd-m');
        const s = document.getElementById('cd-s');
        if (h) h.textContent = fmt(Math.floor(d / 3600000));
        if (m) m.textContent = fmt(Math.floor((d % 3600000) / 60000));
        if (s) s.textContent = fmt(Math.floor((d % 60000) / 1000));
        if (d <= 0) { try { end = Date.now() + 18 * 3600000; localStorage.setItem('drip_botw_end', end); } catch (e) { } }
      };
      tick();
      setInterval(tick, 1000);
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
       HERO BAG ROTATION
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    let heroBagIdx = 0;
    function rotateBag() {
      heroBagIdx = (heroBagIdx + 1) % HERO_ROTATION.length;
      const img = document.getElementById('hero-img');
      if (!img) return;
      const isMobile = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 860px)').matches;
      const swapDelayMs = isMobile ? 180 : 500;
      const fadeInFallbackMs = isMobile ? 180 : 300;
      img.style.opacity = '0';
      setTimeout(() => {
        img.src = HERO_ROTATION[heroBagIdx];
        img.onload = () => { img.style.opacity = '1'; };
        setTimeout(() => { img.style.opacity = '1'; }, fadeInFallbackMs);
      }, swapDelayMs);
    }
    setInterval(rotateBag, window.matchMedia('(max-width: 860px)').matches ? 2400 : 4000);

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
       AUDIO
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    function playZip() {
      try {
        const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        const b = ctx.createBuffer(1, ctx.sampleRate * .2, ctx.sampleRate);
        const d = b.getChannelData(0);
        for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) d[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / d.length) * .35;
        const s = ctx.createBufferSource();
        const f = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = 'bandpass'; f.frequency.value = 3000; f.Q.value = .7;
        s.buffer = b; s.connect(f); f.connect(ctx.destination); s.start();
        setTimeout(() => { try { ctx.close(); } catch (e) { } }, 300);
      } catch (e) { }
    }
    function playAdd() {
      try {
        const cartBtn = document.getElementById('cart-btn');
        if (cartBtn) {
          cartBtn.classList.remove('vibe');
          void cartBtn.offsetWidth;
          cartBtn.classList.add('vibe');
          setTimeout(() => cartBtn.classList.remove('vibe'), 520);
        }
        if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(14);
        const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        const o = ctx.createOscillator(); const g = ctx.createGain();
        o.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
        o.frequency.setValueAtTime(523, ctx.currentTime);
        o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(784, ctx.currentTime + .12);
        g.gain.setValueAtTime(.25, ctx.currentTime);
        g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001, ctx.currentTime + .25);
        o.start(); o.stop(ctx.currentTime + .25);
        setTimeout(() => { try { ctx.close(); } catch (e) { } }, 400);
      } catch (e) { }
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
       SMOOTH SCROLL
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    function goto(id, e) {
      if (e) e.preventDefault();
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el) {
        const offset = document.getElementById('nav').offsetHeight || 60;
        window.scrollTo({ top: el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - offset, behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
       COUNTER ANIMATION
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    function animateCounters() {
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(el => {
        const target = parseFloat(el.dataset.count);
        const suffix = el.dataset.suffix || '';
        const isFloat = target % 1 !== 0;
        const dur = 1800; let start = null;
        const frame = ts => {
          if (!start) start = ts;
          const prog = Math.min((ts - start) / dur, 1);
          const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - prog, 3);
          el.textContent = (isFloat ? (target * eased).toFixed(1) : Math.floor(target * eased)) + suffix;
          if (prog < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        };
        requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      });
    }

    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
       INTERSECTION OBSERVER — fade-up + counters
       ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    let countersAnimated = false;
    function fadeObserver() {
      const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
        entries.forEach(en => {
          if (en.isIntersecting) {
            en.target.classList.add('vis');
            io.unobserve(en.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: .12, rootMargin: '0px 0px -30px 0px' });
      document.querySelectorAll('.fade-up:not(.vis)').forEach(el => io.observe(el));

      document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(el => {
        new IntersectionObserver(([en]) => {
          if (en.isIntersecting && !countersAnimated) { countersAnimated = true; animateCounters(); }
        }, { threshold: .5 }).observe(el);
      });
    }

          /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
             GOOGLE SHEETS INTEGRATION
             Send orders to Google Sheet via webhook (Zapier/Make)
             ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    
          const GOOGLE_SHEETS_WEBHOOK = 'YOUR_WEBHOOK_URL_HERE'; // Replace with your Make/Zapier webhook
    
          async function sendOrderToGoogleSheets(orderData) {
            // After customer completes order, send to Google Sheets
            try {
              const response = await fetch(GOOGLE_SHEETS_WEBHOOK, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                  timestamp: new Date().toLocaleString('en-PK'),
                  customerName: orderData.name,
                  phoneNumber: orderData.phone,
                  items: orderData.items,
                  total: orderData.total,
                  deliveryAddress: orderData.address,
                  notes: orderData.notes
                })
              });
              return response.ok;
            } catch (e) {
              console.error('Sheet sync error:', e);
              return false;
            }
          }
